work.description: Brief CLXX raises San Giovanni in Persiceto (diocese of Bologna) to the rank of city; LF38198 → LF38205 across own provenance LF38201 and page number 260 LF38204; LF38268 → LF38274 across running title LF38271; complete 4 May 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF38150–38150; the source closing at LF38279–38282 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quarta maii millesimo octingen- tesimo trigesimo octavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo.
